name: gcp_slot_claim
description: Gateway Coordination Protocol slot claim message signing. Schnorr48 signature covers CBOR-canonicalized claim data.

signature_format.signed_data: CBOR deterministic encoding (RFC 8949 Section 4.2) of slot claim object
signature_format.canonicalization: CBOR deterministic encoding: map keys sorted, shortest integer form

vectors.name: slot_claim_basic
vectors.description: Basic slot claim for slots [0,1,2] by gateway with IID.
vectors.note: CBOR map keys sorted: gateway_iid, slots, superframe_id, timestamp

vectors.name: slot_claim_interleaved
vectors.description: Interleaved mode: gateway ordinal 0 of 3 claims slots 0,3,6...

vectors.name: slot_claim_map_key_order
vectors.description: CBOR deterministic encoding requires sorted keys. 'gateway_iid' < 'slots' < 'superframe_id' < 'timestamp' (lexicographic).

vectors.name: slot_claim_missing_signature_reject
vectors.description: Slot claim without signature MUST be rejected.

vectors.name: slot_claim_invalid_signature_reject
vectors.description: Slot claim with invalid signature MUST be rejected.

vectors.name: slot_claim_conflict_both_valid
vectors.description: Overlapping claims where both signatures verify: lowest IID wins.
